title: OpenAI quota auto-pause only filtered transiently and did not visibly pause accounts

preconditions: OpenAI account is active and schedulable
Codex 5h used percent exceeds configured auto-pause threshold
steps: select an OpenAI account for a request
reproduction.expected: account is not selected and is persisted as rate-limited until the quota window reset time, without setting a permanent error
reproduction.actual: account was only skipped transiently; account remained schedulable in persistent state

progress.note: Capture bug basics and reproduction signals

progress.action: Archive bug with automated regression test
Correct archive semantics after product clarification
progress.note: Quota threshold auto-pause now follows the existing 429 rate-limit flow via rate_limit_reset_at instead of SetError, so scheduling resumes after the reset window.

resolution.root_cause: OpenAI quota threshold filtering only skipped candidates during selection; sticky previous_response_id and scheduler candidate pools could still keep over-threshold accounts in circulation without recording a temporary reset window.
resolution.fix_summary: Apply quota auto-pause through SetRateLimited using the Codex quota window reset time, gate previous_response_id and scheduler candidate paths, and keep sticky bindings intact so the chain can resume after reset.
